verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents an 'amount splits' feature implemented via API steps (rainforest-docs-6), supporting the core idea of routing a charge across parties, but there is no evidence of split objects being adjustable or reversible after the fact, no detail on how many parties can be split among, and no confirmation these splits are exposed as standalone first-class API objects rather than a payment-creation parameter. Missing for 10: adjustable/reversible split objects, multi-party routing detail, explicit object model documentation, and independent corroboration.
